To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed method outperforms the state of the art in Imitation learning, and that the method is very simple and can be easily implemented.
(a) Imitating actions of experts is a good strategy, and (b) Imitating action sequences is even better.
(1) We show that appending frequent expert action sequences to the action space of a Reinforcement Learning agent can improve the performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how much of expert knowledge can be transferred to a novice in a stochastic environment.
the question: How can we use a few expert action-sequence to improve the training of novice agents in Reinforcement Learning?
the following question: Can we improve the performance of Reinforcement Learning agents by mimicking the behavior (actions) of an expert agent?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed technique can be used to improve the training of a novice in an RL environment by mimicking the actions of an expert.
our method is a simple and fast way to improve the performance of Reinforcement Learning agents in a variety of environments.
, for the novice agent in the beginning, it is better to learn to mimic the expert actions than to explore the environment and discover new states.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that the actions that are taken frequently by the expert are good enough to help the novice agent in its learning and can be used to enhance the performance of a new agent.
, by simply mimicking the actions of the expert, we can improve the exploration capabilities of a novice in a stochastic MDP.
the new agent can learn to perform actions similar to an expert in a fraction of the time required by traditional methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is easier for an agent to learn a mapping from state to action when it is provided with short action sequences that are frequent in the expert’s behavior.
the actions that the expert has performed frequently can act as a guide to the novice and can help it explore more efficiently.
the order in which actions are taken by the expert is important and that it may be a good strategy to mimic the actions in the same order as the expert.
